source.section: The Basics: Prime and Composite Numbers

problem.text: The acute angles of a right triangle are $a^\circ$ and $b^\circ$, where $a > b$ and both $a$ and $b$ are prime numbers. What is the least possible value of $b$?

steps.title: Where to start: the two acute angles are linked
steps.body: The angles of any triangle add to $180^\circ$, and the right angle already uses $90^\circ$. So $a$ and $b$ are not independent: once you pick $b$, the value of $a$ is fixed. That turns the problem into a short search.

your_turn.prompt: What must $a + b$ equal? Write $a$ in terms of $b$.

steps.title: Test the smallest primes for $b$
steps.body: We want the least $b$, so try primes for $b$ in increasing order and check whether $a = 90 - b$ is also prime. Every prime except $2$ is odd, so after $2$ we only need to try odd values.

your_turn.prompt: Check $b = 2$ and $b = 3$. Is $a$ prime in either case?
your_turn.answer: No. $b = 2$ gives $a = 88$, which is even. $b = 3$ gives $a = 87 = 3\cdot 29$.

steps.title: Checking primes quickly
steps.body: Careful: $87$ looks prime, but its digit sum is $15$, so $3$ divides it. To test whether a number below $100$ is prime, you only need to try dividing by $2$, $3$, $5$ and $7$, because $\sqrt{100} = 10$. For $b = 5$ we get $a = 85$, which ends in $5$, so that fails too.

your_turn.answer: No. $91 = 7\cdot 13$, which you find by trying $7$.

steps.title: Put it together
steps.body: The next prime is $b = 7$, which gives $a = 90 - 7 = 83$. The number $83$ is odd, has digit sum $11$, does not end in $0$ or $5$, and $83 = 7\cdot 11 + 6$, so it is prime. Also $83 > 7$, as required. The least possible value of $b$ is $7$. The answer is **(D)**.

wrong_choices.A: This picks the smallest prime without checking $a$. With $b = 2$ we get $a = 88$, which is even and not prime.
wrong_choices.B: This happens if you think $87$ is prime. Its digits add to $15$, so $87 = 3\cdot 29$.

verification.verifier_notes: Independent reviewer re-derived the answer, checked the text against the book image, and found no holes.
